name: claude-me
description: Loreano's Claude Code mods: agent dashboard, limit saver, session duo.

plugins.name: agent-dashboard
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat showing what the session's agents and tools are doing, plus turns, context and usage limits.

plugins.name: limit-saver
plugins.description: Sends simple requests (summaries, translations, rewording, short questions) to Haiku to spare your usage limits.

plugins.name: session-duo
plugins.description: Two Claude Code sessions that talk: one plans, the other builds.
